cohort: Children with T1DM and their healthy siblings
finding: Birth weight, birth height, maternal weight gain during pregnancy, gestational hypertension, neonatal jaundice, cesarean section, being non-first-born, premature rupture of membrane, maternal urinary tract infection, and nonexclusive breastfeeding were significantly associated with an increased risk of T1DM in childhood.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of T1DM in childhood (OR = 2.06).
